title: Single sqlite3 connection shared across all requests
evidence: app.py:57-58 create_app() opens one connection reused by every request; safe under single-threaded wsgiref.simple_server but sqlite3's default check_same_thread=True would raise under a threaded/WSGI-prod server
suggestion: Open a connection per request or pass check_same_thread=False with a lock if a threaded server is intended

title: 405 Method Not Allowed handled beyond spec
evidence: app.py:65,82,88 return 405 for unsupported methods on /health, /books, and /books/{id}
suggestion: None — this is a correctness improvement over the spec

title: Type validation for optional year/isbn beyond required fields
evidence: app.py:43-50 validate() rejects non-int year (excluding bool) and non-string isbn, exceeding the title/author-only requirement
